name: Split view
description: Two or more chats open at once: a split view beside the chat you are in, with up to three chats live, each with its own composer, and a chat beside yours in the side panel.
author: Codex Mods
about: Drag a chat from the sidebar onto a pane of the split view, or choose "Open in split view" in a chat's menu. Each pane is the chat itself, with its own composer, its approvals and its questions.
Command-Shift-Backslash shows or hides the split view; "Next pane" and "Previous pane" move the keyboard between the chats on the screen. The panes and their sizes come back after a restart.

settings.title: Panes
settings.description: How many chats the split view holds.

settings.title: Keyboard shortcuts
settings.description: Command-Backslash opens the current chat beside it; Command-Shift-Backslash shows or hides the split view.
